Author and maintain AI risk management playbooks, standard operating procedures, guides, and living FAQ documents that enable AI use case owners to satisfy federal and agency risk management requirements. Translate federal AI policy into practical, actionable guidance for a non-specialist VHA audience (Executive Order 13960, OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22, and the VA Trustworthy AI Framework). Advise AI use case owners on the development and execution of AI risk management plans through working sessions, office hours, and asynchronous support, at a cadence of at least one working session per month. Design and execute the AI risk stratification pilot, including a new methodology for evaluating and assigning risk levels to AI systems, and evaluate its results. Support VHA business units in creating and updating their AI innovation and governance strategies, covering at least five business units. Develop training materials and deliver training webinars for AI use case owners and AI oversight personnel. Provide expert content and programming for the VHA AI Assessment Subcommittee, field AI committees, and other centralized governance entities, including trainings and summits. Research emerging AI risk management approaches and tools from published and publicly available literature, webinars, and vendor developments for briefings to Institute leadership and government stakeholders.
